Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_testing_mission_1
Reply.text: Well, hello, mercenary. What are you interested in? Maybe... Money? Goods?

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_testing_mission_3
Reply.text: Ah, so you need a job... No problem, you'll get a job, but only when you show what you're really worth. You know, I don't know you, and I can't give important assignments to just anyone. Show yourself in a good light, complete the tasks, and you'll get money, and goods, and more important assignments. So, what's the deal?

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_testing_mission_5
Reply.text: That's great. So listen, your first task: we have a bunch of bandits here, they're roaming around the area, they're called the Scavs. Shoot, say, 5 of these scavs, and get 3 Hornet machine guns from them. That'll be your first task. Get to work, mercenary!|@FF0000AA|@FF1D1D1DReward:|- Machine gun: @FF1D1D1DSpecter - x1|- Item: @FF1D1D1DAmmo box for Machine gun - x1|- Money: @FF1D1D1D20.000 coins
Reply.nextReplies: Dlg_pl_q_testing_mission_6 Dlg_pl_q_testing_mission_7 Dlg_pl_q_testing_mission_8 Dlg_pl_q_testing_mission_9 Dlg_pl_q_testing_mission_10 Dlg_pl_q_testing_mission_11 Dlg_pl_q_testing_mission_12

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_testing_mission_13
Reply.text: So, you've completed the task, well done. I bet you got some machine guns somewhere cheap? Well, it doesn't matter, I'll still need them. As long as you do everything right, we can continue working.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_testing_mission_15
Reply.text: So, you've completed the task, well done. I see you've tried hard. Those machine guns you brought are imported, they're a bit different from ours, they hit a bit harder and have more ammunition. A great trophy, I'll take it for myself. However, I don't advise going into battle with such a gun, heh-heh. So be it, I'm owed a more valuable reward. As long as you do everything well, then we can continue working.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_search_data_1
Reply.text: After completing the last task, you ask to give you the next one? Well, I like this approach. Yes, there is one matter.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_search_data_3
Reply.text: Anyway, listen. One of my fighters hasn't been in touch for a long time, enough time has passed, and he still hasn't shown up. Most likely, he died. However, he was carrying me some important information that I still need. I sent him to an abandoned hospital, the one that is on the Krai location. Find out what happened to him and, if possible, get the information. I will not remain in debt.|@FF0000AA|@FF1D1D1DReward:|- Machine gun: @FF1D1D1DKord - x1|- Item: @FF1D1D1DAmmo box for Machine gun - x1|- Money: @FF1D1D1D25.000 coins

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_search_data_7
Reply.text: So he died after all. You say there were a lot of scavs near the hospital? He was unlucky. Good for him for coping. Here is my share as promised.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_explore_r1m1_1
Reply.text: Okay fighter, here's your next task. Drive through these points on the Krai location and scout out the situation around them. I'm not asking you to clear them out, just scout them out. And then we'll see what to do. Well, can you handle it?|@FF0000AA|@FF1D1D1DReward:|- Cabin: @FF1D1D1DMule (Van, Level II) on sale|- Machine gun: @FF1D1D1DPKT - x1|- Item: @FF1D1D1DAmmo box for Machine gun - x1|- Money: @FF1D1D1D35.000 coins

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_explore_r1m1_5
Reply.text: How did it go? Although you don't have to tell, I already know it was successful. Please, a reward for the completed quest. And yes, if you need a job, you know who to contact.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_clearing_r1m1_1
Reply.text: Hello, mercenary! How are you? Alive and well?

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_clearing_r1m1_2
Reply.text: Great. Then listen then. From your intelligence coordinates we now know that the Krai location is surrounded by bandits. The territory itself is not rich, so it attracts few people. And this means that there will be no strong resistance.

Reply.name: Dlg_pl_q_clearing_r1m1_3
Reply.text: So, what is required of me?

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_clearing_r1m1_4
Reply.text: Your task: to stir up trouble in these points of the location and clear them out. Considering your past successes, you can handle this too. And from me, as usual, a reward and something else, but what exactly, you will find out when you complete the task. Well, how about it? Ready?|@FF0000AA|@FF1D1D1DReward:|- Body: @FF1D1D1DGrob (Van, Level III) on sale|- Machine gun: @FF1D1D1DKord - x1|- Item: @FF1D1D1DAmmo box for Machine gun on sale - x1|- Quest item: @FF1D1D1DKrai map|- Money: @FF1D1D1D40.000 coins

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_clearing_r1m1_8
Reply.text: Wow, successful again? And I see you're not a bad warrior. Well, I owe you one. If you did a good job, then the reward should be appropriate. Right? Well then. The Mechanic took an interest in you, he says he has some business for you. You go see him, okay? And don't forget about me, heh.

Reply.name: Dlg_pl_q_clearing_r1m1_9
Reply.text: Well, let's see what kind of Mechanic you have there.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_kill_scavs_1
Reply.text: Hello, mercenary! I've been thinking about you, and this is what I've realized: Since you're still alive, it means you can do something. That's good, it means I can work with you.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_kill_scavs_3
Reply.text: Here's a task for you. The location is Krai, my guys have their own business there, but these business are hampered by the local scum, who for some reason imagined themselves to be the masters of this territory, even built their base somewhere in the gorge. In general, there are enough bandits there, and we should deal with them. I think for someone like you, this will not cause problems. Get to work!|@FF0000AA|@FF1D1D1DReward:|- Machine gun: @FF1D1D1DPKT on sale - x1|- Random reward|- Money: @FF1D1D1D20.000 coins

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_kill_scavs_7
Reply.text: I see you've done a great job. Excellent. My guys asked me to tell you that you've helped them a lot, so you've got a double reward, from me and from my guys.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_fuel1_1
Reply.text: Mercenary, you've come at just the right time!

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_fuel1_3
Reply.text: You see, we have a fuel shortage here. And fuel is Life. Without it, cars won't work, and generators will stop producing energy. Do you understand what I'm getting at?

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_fuel1_5
Reply.text: First we'll need a few canisters of fuel, I think 3 will be enough for now. Get them, and then I'll tell you what to do next. Deal?|@FF0000AA|@FF1D1D1DReward:|- Cabin: @FF1D1D1DScorpio (Van, Level III) on sale|- Machine gun: @FF1D1D1DKord - x1|- Item: @FF1D1D1DAmmo box for Machine gun - x1|- Item: @FF1D1D1DImproved machinery - x2|- Money: @FF1D1D1D40.000 coins

Reply.name: Dlg_pl_q_fuel1_7
Reply.scriptCondition: HasPlayerAmountOfItems('fuel_full_use', 1) and not(GetVar('q_fuel1_item_fuel').AsInt>=2) and IsQuestTaken('q_fuel1_1') and not(IsQuestComplete('q_fuel1_1'))

Reply.name: Dlg_pl_q_fuel1_8
Reply.scriptCondition: HasPlayerAmountOfItems('fuel_full_use', 1) and GetVar('q_fuel1_item_fuel').AsInt>=2 and IsQuestTaken('q_fuel1_1') and not(IsQuestComplete('q_fuel1_1'))

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_fuel1_10
Reply.text: I see a fighter with canisters. Thank you, you are doing a good deed. This will allow us to hold out a little longer.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_fuel2_1
Reply.text: Well, soldier, I was just waiting for you. Remember that we still haven't solved the problem with the fuel deficit?

Reply.name: Dlg_pl_q_fuel2_2
Reply.text: Of course, I also brought you some canisters.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_fuel2_3
Reply.text: Yes, they were very useful to us, but of course it's not enough. Listen then. I'm going to send my guys on an expedition to the Krai location in a few days, and I wouldn't want them to get stuck in the middle of the road, surrounded by Scavs due to a lack of fuel. So I ask the following from you: check the gas stations for functionality and bring more canisters of fuel. That way I'll be calmer, knowing that the guys will be able to get fuel if necessary. Is the task clear? Then let's get to work!|@FF0000AA|@FF1D1D1DReward:|- Machine gun: @FF1D1D1DKord on sale - x1|- Item: @FF1D1D1DStrong metal - x2|- Item: @FF1D1D1DImproved machinery - x2|- Money: @FF1D1D1D40.000 coins

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_fuel2_5
Reply.scriptCondition: HasPlayerAmountOfItems('fuel_full_use', 1) and not(GetVar('q_fuel2_item_fuel').AsInt>=2) and IsQuestTaken('q_fuel2_4') and not(IsQuestComplete('q_fuel2_4'))

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_fuel2_6
Reply.scriptCondition: HasPlayerAmountOfItems('fuel_full_use', 1) and GetVar('q_fuel2_item_fuel').AsInt>=2 and IsQuestTaken('q_fuel2_4') and not(IsQuestComplete('q_fuel2_4'))

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_fuel2_9
Reply.text: Thank you for your help, I'll pass your coordinates to the guys. Now, finally, we can stock up on fuel from these gas stations. It's a pleasure to deal with you, here's your reward.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_base_scavs_1
Reply.text: Hello, fighter. Remember how I once mentioned the military base that the Scavs built on the Krai location?

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_base_scavs_3
Reply.text: Excellent. So, here comes an order to identify the exact location of this base. You can't trust this task to just anyone. And here - you. In short, here's a beacon, easy to use. Arrive at the marking site, press the button, install it, leave, that's it - the signal is transmitted. Just be careful not to lose it, you'll have to buy the rest for money. Is that clear? Then get to work, soldier!|@FF0000AA|@FF1D1D1DReward:|- Machine gun: @FF1D1D1DPKT on sale - x1|- Machine gun: @FF1D1D1DKord on sale - x1|- Money: @FF1D1D1D35.000 coins

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_base_scavs_7
Reply.text: Hello again! Signal with the base location received, job done. I don't know how you do it, but it's none of my business. The main thing is that you do everything clearly and according to plan. Your reward.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_base_scavs_8
Reply.text: It's a pleasure to work with you.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_kill_usec_1
Reply.text: Greetings, mercenary! How are you, ready for more serious matters?

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_kill_usec_3
Reply.text: Okay. You're certainly a warrior with serious intentions, as I see it, heh-heh. Anyway, straight to the point. Lately, the USEC have started to annoy me. They're crawling everywhere they want and killing my people. I don't like it. Give them a good beating, and I'll give you some dough. Deal? And as proof, bring me their dog tags.|@FF0000AA|@FF1D1D1DReward:|@FF404040- Transport: @FF1D1D1DLorry on sale @FF780a0a[If not received earlier]|@FF404040- Machine gun: @FF1D1D1DKord - x1|@FF404040- Item: @FF1D1D1DAmmo box for Machine gun - x1|@FF404040- Item: @FF1D1D1DGolden clock - x1

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_kill_usec_5
Reply.scriptCondition: HasPlayerAmountOfItems('item_jeton_usec', 1) and not(GetVar('q_kill_usec_item_jeton').AsInt >= 4) and IsQuestTaken('q_kill_usec_2') and not(IsQuestComplete('q_kill_usec_2'))

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_kill_usec_6
Reply.scriptCondition: HasPlayerAmountOfItems('item_jeton_usec', 1) and GetVar('q_kill_usec_item_jeton').AsInt >= 4 and IsQuestTaken('q_kill_usec_2') and not(IsQuestComplete('q_kill_usec_2'))

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_kill_usec_9
Reply.text: Keep it up! Here are your gifts, soldier. You've done a good job, you've caused a real stir. Now they'll know who they're dealing with.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_kill_usec_10
Reply.text: Great. If anything happens, you know who to contact.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_kill_pmc_1
Reply.text: Greetings, mercenary! Listen, I see that you seem to be a normal fighter, you've never let me down and you do everything according to plan. I respect that, which means I can trust you with a more serious task. Ready?

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_kill_pmc_3
Reply.text: Anyway, listen, there's a group of PMCs that keeps trying to screw me over. I've had my eye on them for a while now, so it's time to get rid of them. Can you help them out? If you do, bring them their dog tags as proof. There will be a reward, don't worry.|@FF0000AA|@FF1D1D1DReward:|@FF404040- Transport: @FF1D1D1DLorry on sale @FF780a0a[If not received earlier]|@FF404040- Machine gun: @FF1D1D1DKord - x1|@FF404040- Item: @FF1D1D1DAmmo box for Machine gun - x1|@FF404040- Item: @FF1D1D1DGolden chain - x1|@FF404040- Money: @FF1D1D1D10.000 coins

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_kill_pmc_9
Reply.text: You took down the bastards? Well done. Judging by the tokens, it was them. Mission accomplished, soldier! Here you go, sign for it.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_sectarian1_1
Reply.text: Hi! Come on over, I have a job for you. Such things are happening in the area, in short. Recently my boys went on a night raid to the Krai location for loot and ran into some guys in hoods. Of course, not all of the guys survived, those who could, eventually ran away. Who these bastards were, no one knows. Anyway, the guys found something like a ritual circle nearby. Its approximate location is between the Road to Ridzin and the settlement of Zaimka. Here, take the beacon, your task is to mark this place and transfer us its exact location. Is the task clear? Then get to work, soldier!|@FF0000AA|@FF1D1D1DReward:|@FF404040- Gadget: @FF1D1D1DRolled armour plates for the cabin hull - x1|@FF404040- Item: @FF1D1D1DImproved machinery - x2|@FF404040- Money: @FF1D1D1D40.000 coins

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_sectarian1_6
Reply.text: Great, signal received. I sent an expedition there, we'll figure out what's wrong with these crazy people. Good thing he wasn't hurt. Although, as I see, you can handle any job. Take your reward.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_sectarian2_1
Reply.text: So, I have a new job for you. Look what I have. This is the knife of those same psychos my boys ran into. During the brawl, they took out a couple of these bastards and found this very knife on one of them. The product, as you can see, is unusual, with strange signs. In short, there is clearly something wrong with these guys, it turns out that serious people are ready to fork out a fortune for such a product. If you happen to find a few more of these knives, bring them to me immediately.|@FF0000AA|@FF1D1D1DReward:|@FF404040- Gadget: @FF1D1D1DFuel system isolation - x1|@FF404040- Laser launcher: @FF1D1D1DMaxim - x1|@FF404040- Item: @FF1D1D1DLiquid cylinder for Laser launcher - x1|@FF404040- Money: @FF1D1D1D50.000 coins

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_sectarian2_7
Reply.text: You really did bring them. Well done. You took down the sectarians yourself? There's something fishy about these guys, I'm telling you the truth.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_sectarian2_8
Reply.text: Yes, I had to tinker with them.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_new_year_2026_1
Reply.text: Hey, how are you getting ready for the holiday? Even in such difficult times, you need to be able to take a break from all the hustle and bustle and enjoy the holiday. I've seen a lot of fighters, and I'll tell you this: if your mind is full of battles and nothing but combat skills, you'll quickly lose it. So, put the battles away and start preparing for the holiday, and don't forget to decorate the christmas tree.|@FF0000AA|@FF1D1D1DReward:|@FF404040- Item: @FF1D1D1DVodka - x1|@FF404040- Quest item: @FF1D1D1DPurple christmas ball|@FF404040- Money: @FF1D1D1D30.000 coins

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_new_year_2026_2
Reply.text: You're right, I'll do that now.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_new_year_2026_4
Reply.text: I'm already prepared for the holiday.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_new_year_2026_6
Reply.text: Well done, that's a different matter. Enjoy the moment while you can. And don't get too drunk there, it's bad for your health, heh-heh.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_new_year_2026_7
Reply.text: That's good. Enjoy the moment while you can. And don't get too drunk there, it's bad for your health, heh-heh.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_new_year_2026_8
Reply.text: Thank you, same to you. Happy holidays!

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_daily_kill_pmc_prapor_1
Reply.text: Hello, mercenary! I have a task for you. We need to clear the area of several PMCs. Can you handle it? There will be a reward, don't worry.|@FF0000AA|@FF1D1D1DObjectives:|- Kill a certain number of PMC fighters||@FF0000AA|@FF1D1D1DReward:|- Unknown reward

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_daily_kill_pmc_prapor_5
Reply.text: You've completed the task, keep it up. Take your reward.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_daily_kill_scav_prapor_1
Reply.text: Hello, mercenary! I have one job for you. Lately, the locals have gone completely wild, constantly preventing us from completing our tasks. In short, we need to scare the bandits a little. Will you take it?|@FF0000AA|@FF1D1D1DObjectives:|- Kill a certain number of scavs||@FF0000AA|@FF1D1D1DReward:|- Unknown reward

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_daily_kill_scav_prapor_5
Reply.text: So you did great. Here's your reward, sign for it.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_daily_extract_r1m1_prapor_1
Reply.text: Hello, soldier! Listen, we need help with reconnaissance - to walk around a couple of places, comb through the situation there, and how to retreat to a safe place if necessary. Not for nothing, of course, there will be a reward, and the matter is a piece of cake. Come on, get ready, we'll wait for news.|@FF0000AA|@FF1D1D1DObjectives:|- Survive and exit the Krai location a certain number of times||@FF0000AA|@FF1D1D1DReward:|- Unknown reward

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_daily_extract_prapor_5
Reply.text: Great, now we know the situation on the location. I'll mark dangerous places and escape routes on my map, thank you. Your reward.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_rebuild_1
Reply.text: Ahh... Who the hell are you? Can't you see I'm busy!

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_rebuild_2
Reply.text: I apologize for disturbing you, the Prapor sent me to you. He says that you have some business for me.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_rebuild_3
Reply.text: Oh, is that you? Sorry for being a jerk. I repair parts from damaged cars, or assemble new ones from various junk. Oh yeah, I forgot to introduce myself, I'm a Mechanic.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_rebuild_4
Reply.text: The job is really not easy, but why do you actually need me?

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_rebuild_5
Reply.text: Yes, there is one thing to do. But one task is resisting it, and without finishing it, I cannot take on another.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_rebuild_6
Reply.text: What needs to be done to speed up the process?

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_rebuild_7
Reply.text: I'm missing some spare parts, they can of course be ordered, but as you understand, it's time. If you help me, I'll be grateful, it will allow us to move on to the main task faster.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_rebuild_8
Reply.text: Okay, what parts do I need to find to complete the job?

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_rebuild_9
Reply.text: So, to finish the job, I need just one thing: one car battery and 2 spark plugs. Bring them to me, and then I can finish the repair job.|@FF0000AA|@FF1D1D1DReward:|- Transport: @FF1D1D1DLorry on sale @FF780a0a[If not received earlier]|- Cabin: @FF1D1D1DWhirlpool (Lorry, Level II) on sale|- Machine gun: @FF1D1D1DKord - x1|- Item: @FF1D1D1DAmmo box for Machine gun - x1|- Money: @FF1D1D1D50.000 coins
Reply.nextReplies: Dlg_npc_q_rebuild_10 Dlg_npc_q_rebuild_12 Dlg_npc_q_rebuild_13 Dlg_npc_q_rebuild_14 Dlg_npc_q_rebuild_15 Dlg_npc_q_rebuild_16

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_rebuild_10
Reply.text: Okay, I'll try to find them as quickly as possible.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_rebuild_13
Reply.scriptCondition: HasPlayerAmountOfItems('item_svech', 1) and not(GetVar('q_rebuild_item_svech').AsInt>=1) and IsQuestTaken('q_rebuild_2') and not(IsQuestComplete('q_rebuild_2'))

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_rebuild_14
Reply.scriptCondition: HasPlayerAmountOfItems('item_svech', 1) and GetVar('q_rebuild_item_svech').AsInt>=1 and IsQuestTaken('q_rebuild_2') and not(IsQuestComplete('q_rebuild_2'))

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_rebuild_17
Reply.text: Wow! You finally brought them! Thank you. Now I can finally finish the repairs. Here is your reward. Drop by in a couple of days, maybe I will be free by then.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_prapor_insure_1
Reply.text: If you want to insure your belongings, you have come to the right place. I provide some of the best insurance services. What gear do you want to insure?|@FF0000AA|@FF1D1D1D[For insurance, put the necessary items in your truck bed]
Reply.nextReplies: Dlg_pl_insure_1 Dlg_pl_insure_2 Dlg_pl_insure_3 Dlg_pl_insure_4 Dlg_pl_insure_5 Dlg_pl_insure_6 Dlg_pl_insure_7 Dlg_pl_insure_8 Dlg_pl_insure_9 Dlg_pl_insure_10 Dlg_pl_insure_11 Dlg_pl_insure_12 Dlg_pl_insure_13 Dlg_pl_insure_14 Dlg_pl_insure_15 Dlg_pl_insure_16 Dlg_pl_insure_17 Dlg_pl_insure_18 Dlg_pl_insure_19 Dlg_pl_insure_20 Dlg_pl_insure_21 Dlg_pl_insure_22 Dlg_pl_insure_23 Dlg_pl_insure_23_ Dlg_pl_insure_24 Dlg_pl_insure_25 Dlg_pl_insure_26 Dlg_pl_insure_27 Dlg_pl_insure_28 Dlg_pl_insure_29 Dlg_pl_insure_30 Dlg_pl_insure_31 Dlg_pl_insure_32 Dlg_pl_insure_33 Dlg_pl_insure_34 Dlg_pl_insure_35 Dlg_pl_insure_36 Dlg_pl_insure_37 Dlg_pl_insure_38 Dlg_pl_insure_39 Dlg_pl_insure_40 Dlg_pl_insure_41 Dlg_pl_insure_42 Dlg_pl_insure_43 Dlg_pl_npc_exit

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_prapor_insure_2
Reply.text: Your things have been returned under insurance, you can pick them up.

Reply.name: Dlg_pl_insure_1
Reply.scriptCondition: IfCanGunInSlot('hornet01') > 0 and GetPlayerMoney() >= 600 or HasPlayerAmountOfItems('hornet01', 1) and GetPlayerMoney() >= 600

Reply.name: Dlg_pl_insure_2

Reply.scriptCondition: IfCanGunInSlot('specter01') > 0 and GetPlayerMoney() >= 1700 or HasPlayerAmountOfItems('specter01', 1) and GetPlayerMoney() >= 1700

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_first_in_line_1
Reply.text: Good afternoon, young man, are you by any chance interested in a job?

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_first_in_line_3
Reply.text: That's good. We haven't met yet. Everyone calls me Therapist. I think it's clear from my name what I do. I was told that you're looking for a job. Do a short task for me - we'll work together.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_first_in_line_5
Reply.text: There is a hospital at the Krai location, after the disaster the building remained untouched, all the equipment should be in working order. Find this place and take some medicine with you. Afterwards I will send my people to check the territory.|@FF0000AA|@FF1D1D1DReward:|@FF404040- Item: @FF1D1D1DStrong metal - x1|@FF404040- Item: @FF1D1D1DImproved machinery - x1|@FF404040- Money: @FF1D1D1D15.000 coins

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_shortage_1
Reply.text: Hello, mercenary. Yes, I have an easy job for you, you won't lose out. You can always buy provisions, drinks, and the most valuable thing - qualified medical care from me. So, I need to get a few emergency medical kits. They are called «Salewa» - red ones, Western ones. That's what I need. And it is imperative that they be obtained by your own hands, as proof that you are a serious person. Can you handle it?|@FF0000AA|@FF1D1D1DReward:|@FF404040- Item: @FF1D1D1DImproved machinery - x2|@FF404040- Money: @FF1D1D1D20.000 coins

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_shortage_3
Reply.scriptCondition: HasPlayerAmountOfItems('item_salewa', 1) and not(GetVar('q_shortage_item_salewa').AsInt >= 2) and IsQuestTaken('q_shortage') and not(IsQuestComplete('q_shortage'))

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_shortage_4
Reply.scriptCondition: HasPlayerAmountOfItems('item_salewa', 1) and GetVar('q_shortage_item_salewa').AsInt >= 2 and IsQuestTaken('q_shortage') and not(IsQuestComplete('q_shortage'))

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_shortage_6
Reply.text: It's always nice to work with someone you can rely on. Thank you very much. I can't say why I needed them, but believe me, it's for a good cause.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_shortage_7
Reply.text: It feels good to do good deeds.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_sanitary_standards1_1
Reply.text: Good day. I have some urgent work for you. It is important for everyone who still lives, or, more accurately, exists in our unfortunate world. I have serious suspicions that some kind of nasty stuff is leaking into the groundwater from the plant. And due to the lack of outside supplies, we are all forced to drink untreated water. Do you understand?

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_sanitary_standards1_2
Reply.text: The problem is really serious. How can I help you?

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_sanitary_standards1_3
Reply.text: To figure this out, I need gas analyzer readings. Can you help me find them?|@FF0000AA|@FF1D1D1DReward:|@FF404040- Item: @FF1D1D1DStrong metal on sale - x1|@FF404040- Item: @FF1D1D1DStrong metal - x1|@FF404040- Money: @FF1D1D1D14.000 coins

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_sanitary_standards1_5
Reply.text: Good day. I have some urgent work for you. It is important for everyone who still lives, or, more accurately, exists in our unfortunate world. I have serious suspicions that some kind of nasty stuff is leaking into the groundwater from the plant. And due to the lack of outside supplies, we are all forced to drink untreated water. To figure this out, I need gas analyzer readings. Can you help me find them?|@FF0000AA|@FF1D1D1DReward:|@FF404040- Item: @FF1D1D1DStrong metal on sale - x1|@FF404040- Item: @FF1D1D1DStrong metal - x1|@FF404040- Money: @FF1D1D1D14.000 coins

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_sanitary_standards1_8
Reply.text: Thank you. Very timely. You did an important thing for many, if not for all.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_sanitary_standards2_1
Reply.text: Hello. It's good that you stopped by. I have a job for you that you are already familiar with. Our engineers have successfully neutralized the chemical leak, but the water is still not completely purified. Although there are only impurities typical of petroleum products left. Get a couple more Gas analyzers, and then we will solve the water problems in the region at least for a while.|@FF0000AA|@FF1D1D1DReward:|@FF404040- Item: @FF1D1D1DImproved machinery on sale - x1|@FF404040- Item: @FF1D1D1DImproved machinery - x1|@FF404040- Money: @FF1D1D1D20.000 coins

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_sanitary_standards2_2
Reply.text: Okay, what can't you do for the common good.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_sanitary_standards2_6
Reply.text: It's good that a responsible person was found who is ready to take a risk for the common good.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_sanitary_standards2_7
Reply.text: Thank you. I hope this really helps.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_painkiller_1
Reply.text: Good day, mercenary. I have another job, if you're interested, of course.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_painkiller_2
Reply.text: I'm interested. Tell me what needs to be done.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_painkiller_3
Reply.text: I think you already understood that I support the civilians who remained in the shelters, who unfortunately suffered from the disaster. In fact, all your showdowns are just a means to an end for me. And there is only one end - to help innocent people recover and get back on their feet. After all, I am a doctor, and I took an oath. Therefore, I ask you to get me some morphine, at least a few pieces.|@FF0000AA|@FF1D1D1DReward:|@FF404040- Item: @FF1D1D1DSilicone tube - x1|@FF404040- Item: @FF1D1D1DSet of medicines - x1|@FF404040- Item: @FF1D1D1DTablets «Analgin» - x1|@FF404040- Money: @FF1D1D1D25.000 coins

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_painkiller_4
Reply.text: Okay, I'll try to look. If I find it, I'll bring it to you.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_painkiller_5
Reply.scriptCondition: HasPlayerAmountOfItems('item_morfie', 1) and not(GetVar('q_painkiller_item_morfie').AsInt >= 3) and IsQuestTaken('q_painkiller_1') and not(IsQuestComplete('q_painkiller_1'))

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_painkiller_6
Reply.scriptCondition: HasPlayerAmountOfItems('item_morfie', 1) and GetVar('q_painkiller_item_morfie').AsInt >= 3 and IsQuestTaken('q_painkiller_1') and not(IsQuestComplete('q_painkiller_1'))

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_painkiller_8
Reply.text: A big human thank you. I won't even explain how much this is and at the same time how critically little it is in our conditions. Most would simply keep it for themselves, and you gave it to those in need. Thank you.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_painkiller_9
Reply.text: Thank you for entrusting this task to me and not to someone else.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_autorem_1
Reply.text: Hello, young man. Your help is needed for a good cause. You probably already know that I am collecting provisions, medical supplies and other necessary things in order to evacuate people. And now they will have enough supplies for the entire journey. And most importantly, I managed to arrange through my channels on the other side for the people to be met and let through! So almost everything is ready, except for one small detail - we need transport. We have several cars that will fit the entire first batch, but they are not running. They have been idle for too long, and, as I was told, we need batteries and spark plugs. We don’t even need fuel. I will make a specific list. Will you deliver?|@FF0000AA|@FF1D1D1DReward:|@FF404040- Item: @FF1D1D1DHigh-tech electronics on sale - x1|@FF404040- Item: @FF1D1D1DHigh-tech electronics - x2|@FF404040- Item: @FF1D1D1DImproved machinery - x2|@FF404040- Item: @FF1D1D1DFirst aid kit «Grizzly» - x1|@FF404040- Money: @FF1D1D1D40.000 coins
Reply.nextReplies: Dlg_npc_q_autorem_2 Dlg_npc_q_autorem_3 Dlg_npc_q_autorem_4 Dlg_npc_q_autorem_5 Dlg_npc_q_autorem_6 Dlg_npc_q_autorem_7 Dlg_npc_q_autorem_8

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_autorem_2
Reply.text: No problem. I'll deliver you batteries with spark plugs. I'm sure I'll be able to find a few from the damaged cars.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_autorem_5
Reply.scriptCondition: HasPlayerAmountOfItems('item_svech', 1) and not(GetVar('q_autorem_item_svech').AsInt >= 3) and IsQuestTaken('q_autorem_2') and not(IsQuestComplete('q_autorem_2'))

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_autorem_6
Reply.scriptCondition: HasPlayerAmountOfItems('item_svech', 1) and GetVar('q_autorem_item_svech').AsInt >= 3 and IsQuestTaken('q_autorem_2') and not(IsQuestComplete('q_autorem_2'))

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_autorem_9
Reply.text: You have no idea what you've done for these people. Thank you.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_autorem_10
Reply.text: Excellent. The civilian population needs to be evacuated, they don't belong in a combat zone.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_private_clinic_1
Reply.text: Hello. As a doctor, I believe that the Hippocratic oath must be observed even in such difficult times. So I had an idea to open a private clinic, you always need to take care of your health, and in our conditions, even more so. But for this I need some equipment. I will give you a list of what you need to bring. I do not need competition, so that unnecessary talk does not begin, it is necessary to obtain the equipment without unnecessary noise and publicity, with my own hands. Of course, I will find how to thank you for your work.|@FF0000AA|@FF1D1D1DReward:|@FF404040- Item: @FF1D1D1DHigh-tech electronics on sale - x1|@FF404040- Item: @FF1D1D1DHigh-tech electronics - x2|@FF404040- Item: @FF1D1D1DAdvanced current converter - x1|@FF404040- Item: @FF1D1D1DCoin EX - x1

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_private_clinic_2
Reply.text: Okay, I'll look for the necessary equipment.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_private_clinic_7
Reply.text: Have you brought it? Great, put it all on my desk. Be careful, the equipment is very fragile. Even if it doesn't work out with the clinic, I know good people who would be interested, between you and me. Why let such expensive equipment go to waste?

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_private_clinic_8
Reply.text: I don't know much about medical equipment, but I think you know better what to do with it.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_crisis_1
Reply.text: Young man, are you busy right now? Interested people from abroad, on the other side of the barricades, are interested in a large consignment of valuable medical equipment. I think they will be able to find a better use for it than this rabble. I would be extremely grateful if you could find the missing instruments for me. Here, take it. This is a list of all the necessary items.|@FF0000AA|@FF1D1D1DReward:|@FF404040- Item: @FF1D1D1DHigh-tech electronics - x4|@FF404040- Item: @FF1D1D1DGolden chain - x2|@FF404040- Item: @FF1D1D1DAnanaga - x1|@FF404040- Money: @FF1D1D1D50.000 coins
Reply.nextReplies: Dlg_npc_q_crisis_2 Dlg_npc_q_crisis_3 Dlg_npc_q_crisis_4 Dlg_npc_q_crisis_5 Dlg_npc_q_crisis_6 Dlg_npc_q_crisis_7 Dlg_npc_q_crisis_8 Dlg_npc_q_crisis_9

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_crisis_2
Reply.text: The list is not small. I'll try to search.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_crisis_10
Reply.text: Excellent, simply excellent. You have done a good deed for all those in need.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_crisis_11
Reply.text: I hope this search was worth it.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_daily_kill_pmc_terapist_1
Reply.text: Hello, mercenary. We need help eliminating a group of targets that are interfering with our humanitarian operations. If you are not busy, I will assign this to you. Full details are attached.|@FF0000AA|@FF1D1D1DObjectives:|- Kill a certain number of PMC fighters||@FF0000AA|@FF1D1D1DReward:|- Unknown reward

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_daily_kill_pmc_terapist_5
Reply.text: Your task is completed, thank you. This is your reward.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_daily_kill_scav_terapist_1
Reply.text: Good day, mercenary. I have a task for a man like you. The locations where we often conduct our operations are teeming with local scum, thus preventing us from completing our assigned tasks. Deal with the bandits? I will have something to repay you with.|@FF0000AA|@FF1D1D1DObjectives:|- Kill a certain number of scavs||@FF0000AA|@FF1D1D1DReward:|- Unknown reward

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_daily_kill_scav_terapist_5
Reply.text: Excellent work. This is your reward for completing the task.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_daily_extract_r1m1_terapist_1
Reply.text: Hello, young man. My workers need to deliver several batches of valuable medicines, but I'm afraid to send them alone. If you have the opportunity, I ask you to help us, for the benefit of the civilian population. All we need from you is to make sure of the reconnaissance and safety of the route. Will you take it on?|@FF0000AA|@FF1D1D1DObjectives:|- Survive and exit the Krai location a certain number of times||@FF0000AA|@FF1D1D1DReward:|- Unknown reward

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_daily_extract_terapist_5
Reply.text: It's good when you have a person you can rely on. Thank you.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_mechanic_1
Reply.text: Hello, friend! How can I help you?

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_mechanic_quests
Reply.text: Now let's see what we can offer you.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_test_drive1_1
Reply.text: Greetings, mercenary! You dropped by just in time, I just finished the repairs.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_test_drive1_2
Reply.text: Let's get straight to the point.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_test_drive1_3
Reply.text: Great. Then listen. An order has come in to assemble and test the machine configuration in combat. I can handle the assembly myself, but it's better to entrust the testing to someone like you. And if you can handle the assembly, you'll get a corresponding reward.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_test_drive1_4
Reply.text: Okay, what configuration does the customer ask to assemble?

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_test_drive1_5
Reply.text: So, the customer needs a budget vehicle assembly, designed for cargo transportation, with average firepower and a larger body capacity. Simply put, the change should be as follows:|@FF0000AA|Car: @FF1D1D1DVan|Cabin: @FF1D1D1DBug (Level I)|Body: @FF1D1D1DGrob (Level III)|Weapon: @FF1D1D1DPKT - x1|@FF0000AA|Can you handle it? If anything, come by, I'll help with advice.|@FF0000AA|@FF1D1D1DReward:|- Unknown reward|- Random reward|- Money: @FF1D1D1D50.000 coins

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_test_drive1_6
Reply.text: It doesn't seem like it's difficult. I can handle it.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_test_drive1_9
Reply.text: Wow, assembled it and tested it. Well done. Everything was done according to plan, the customer will be happy. Your reward is as promised.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_test_drive1_10
Reply.text: Glad to try, especially when they pay.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_test_drive2_1
Reply.text: Hello, last time you didn't let me down with the assembly, so I can rely on you. As usual, I have a lot of work to do, and then there are these orders. Anyway, I need your help.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_test_drive2_2
Reply.text: Okay, tell me what needs to be done.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_test_drive2_3
Reply.text: The customer asks to assemble a maneuverable truck, with the ability to install two guns, and leave the body capacity in stock. The configuration should be as follows:|@FF0000AA|Car: @FF1D1D1DLorry|Cabin: @FF1D1D1DThorn (Level III)|Body: @FF1D1D1DTent (Level I)|Weapon: @FF1D1D1DSpecter - x1, PKT - x1|@FF0000AA|@FF1D1D1DReward:|- Body: @FF1D1D1DGenerator (Lorry, Level II) on sale|- Machine gun: @FF1D1D1DKPVT on sale - x1|- Item: @FF1D1D1DImproved machinery - x2|- Money: @FF1D1D1D60.000 coins

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_test_drive2_4
Reply.text: The task is clear. Wait for me with the assembly.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_test_drive2_7
Reply.text: Okay, you've completed the task. The build is certainly not the best, but that's not up to me to decide. Take your reward.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_test_drive2_8
Reply.text: Yes. I had to ride it.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_test_drive3_1
Reply.text: Oh, hi! We can find a deal, but the order is quite specific.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_test_drive3_3
Reply.text: The customer asks to test the Van assembly in full stock, with the Hornet machine gun installed. He argues this topic by saying that he is really interested in the competitiveness of this old thing in the current conditions. I understand who, the assembly is terrible, but I do not know yet whether to offer this order.|@FF0000AA|@FF1D1D1DReward:|- Body: @FF1D1D1DBox (Lorry, Level III) on sale|- Item: @FF1D1D1DAmmo box for Shotgun on sale - x1|- Item: @FF1D1D1DHigh-tech electronics - x3|- Money: @FF1D1D1D60.000 coins

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_test_drive3_4
Reply.text: Apparently there is no way out. I hope this is the only such order.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_test_drive3_7
Reply.text: Thank you, friend! For me, this order was like a weight off my shoulders, no one wanted to take it. Finally, I got rid of it. I will never take on such an order again, never in my life. Here is your reward.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_test_drive3_8
Reply.text: I hope this is really true.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_test_drive4_1
Reply.text: Hello, mercenary. Here's another build for you, just for someone like you, I think you'll appreciate it.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_test_drive4_3
Reply.text: So, then. You need to assemble a Lorry, with a KPVT machine gun mounted on the body, and leave the cabin stock. These are the main criteria. The assembly is not difficult, so I think you can handle it. So, what do you say?|@FF0000AA|@FF1D1D1DReward:|- Cannon: @FF1D1D1DRapier on sale - x1|- Item: @FF1D1D1DAmmo box for Cannon on sale - x1|- Money: @FF1D1D1D50.000 coins

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_test_drive4_7
Reply.text: I see the testing was successful. The build is good, but the armament could be better. The task is completed, here is your reward.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_test_drive4_8
Reply.text: When the orders are normal, it’s pleasant to work.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_test_drive5_1
Reply.text: Greetings, mercenary! Tell me: Do you like big, cannon calibers? So that they go BAM! And destroy the target with one shot. Here's what I'm getting at. I have a contract for you, need to assemble a Lorry, with a Rapier cannon and a Storm shotgun installed. The build looks interesting, what do you think? Deal?|@FF0000AA|@FF1D1D1DReward:|- Transport: @FF1D1D1DUral on sale|- Unknown reward|- Random reward|- Money: @FF1D1D1D50.000 coins

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_test_drive5_5
Reply.text: Very good. Quite an unusual configuration of the machine turned out. However, the accuracy of shooting is important here, there is no right to make a mistake. And because of the shotgun, it is necessary to reduce the distance. Your reward, as befits an experienced assembler and fighter.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_test_drive6_1
Reply.text: Oh, hi! It's good that you stopped by. You know, in all my time working with weapons, I liked miniguns - for their crazy rate of fire and almost endless belt of cartridges. Thus, they can cause terrifying power. Here's what I'm getting at. I have one order, I need to make a Ural assembly with two Vulcan machine guns installed.|@FF0000AA|Cabin: @FF1D1D1DStandard (Level II)|Body: @FF1D1D1DCold (Level I)|@FF0000AA|Can you handle it?|@FF0000AA|@FF1D1D1DReward:|- Body: @FF1D1D1DFreight (Ural, Level II) on sale|- Machine gun: @FF1D1D1DKPVT on sale - x1|- Item: @FF1D1D1DAmmo box for Machine gun - x2|- Item: @FF1D1D1DAmmo box for Machine gun on sale - x1|- Money: @FF1D1D1D60.000 coins

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_test_drive6_2
Reply.text: It doesn't look difficult. I think I can handle it.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_test_drive6_5
Reply.text: Excellent. According to the tests, the build is average, one more Vulcan is missing to make it complete. I think the customer will pay attention to this and improve the build. Your task is completed, take your reward.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_test_drive6_6
Reply.text: I would completely abandon Vulcans and install something better. Thanks for the award.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_test_drive7_1
Reply.text: Hi, I'm just wondering what to do with this order, so I'll give it to you. Will you take it on? I need to test Lorry, here are the exact instructions.|@FF0000AA|Cabin: @FF1D1D1DBolt (Level I)|Body: @FF1D1D1DGenerator (Level II)|Weapon: @FF1D1D1DKord - x1|@FF0000AA|@FF1D1D1DReward:|- Body: @FF1D1D1DShell (Ural, Level IV) on sale|- Gadget: @FF1D1D1DBlowback system with floating coupling on sale - x1|- Cannon: @FF1D1D1DRapier on sale - x1|- Item: @FF1D1D1DAmmo box for Cannon on sale - x1|- Money: @FF1D1D1D50.000 coins

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_test_drive7_5
Reply.text: Thank you, I was racking my brains trying to decide who to assign this task to, you helped me out. Here's your reward.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_test_drive7_6
Reply.text: For the sake of a good reward, it is worth working hard.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_test_drive8_1
Reply.text: Oh, it's you, hello. I'm looking at you and I see that we haven't had any good builds for a long time, what do you think?

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_test_drive8_2
Reply.text: Perhaps you have some kind of order?

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_test_drive8_3
Reply.text: You think correctly. I have an order, I think you will like it. It is necessary to assemble Ural, with two installed Rapier guns. Here are detailed instructions, read them.|@FF0000AA|Cabin: @FF1D1D1DStandard (Level II)|Body: @FF1D1D1DShell (Level IV)|Weapon: @FF1D1D1DRapier - x2|@FF0000AA|@FF1D1D1DReward:|- Cabin: @FF1D1D1DMorion (Ural, Level IV) on sale|- Gadget: @FF1D1D1DSolenoid actuator on sale - x1|- Cannon: @FF1D1D1DRainmetal on sale - x1|- Item: @FF1D1D1D Ammo box for Cannon - x1|- Money: @FF1D1D1D55.000 coins

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_test_drive8_7
Reply.text: Great, I see you've completed the task, and I didn't expect anything else. How do you like the build? Judging by the tests, the build is not bad, but it's not exactly a smash hit. However, that's not your problem. You've completed the task, here's your reward.

Reply.name: Dlg_pl_q_ural_or_belaz_1
Reply.text: Hello, mercenary! Listen, I have one thing to do. Basically, they want to bring us a batch of Belaz trucks for testing in the near future. Have you seen these?

Reply.name: Dlg_pl_q_ural_or_belaz_2
Reply.text: It happened a couple of times, I met him on the roads.

Reply.name: Dlg_pl_q_ural_or_belaz_3
Reply.text: So, this is a huge machine, with big wheels and excellent armor. Surely, you can make cool assemblies for testing from it. Because of this news, many candidates for testing these Belazs have appeared, so I will ask you directly as an experienced assembler and fighter. Are you interested in assembling and testing these Belazs, or would you prefer to cut through the wastelands on the already proven Ural? Otherwise, I will simply offer the job to another contractor.|@FF0000AA|@FF1D1D1DReward:|- Transport: @FF1D1D1DBelaz on sale|- Item: @FF1D1D1DHigh-tech electronics - x4

Reply.name: Dlg_pl_q_ural_or_belaz_12
Reply.text: Well, have you made up your mind? I'll ask again: Are you interested in assembling and testing Belazs, or would you prefer to cut through the wastelands on the already proven Ural? Otherwise, I'll just offer the job to another contractor.|@FF0000AA|@FF1D1D1DReward:|- Transport: @FF1D1D1DBelaz on sale|- Item: @FF1D1D1DHigh-tech electronics - x4

Reply.name: Dlg_pl_q_ural_or_belaz_5
Reply.text: I am interested in assembling Belazs, I have always dreamed of riding this huge machine.

Reply.name: Dlg_pl_q_ural_or_belaz_7
Reply.text: Well, good. So we'll continue assembling Urals with you, and I'll involve other contractors for Belazs. Thank you for your quick response. Come see me later, I need to sort out some things, when I'm done, we'll continue working.

Reply.name: Dlg_pl_q_ural_or_belaz_9
Reply.text: Okay, glad to hear it. Then I won't consider other candidates and will offer Belaz assemblies to you. Thank you for your quick reply. Come to me later, I need to sort out some things, when I'm done, we'll start working.

Reply.name: Dlg_pl_q_ural_or_belaz_10
Reply.text: Okay, you are free to decide for yourself how to proceed. Just don't delay too long.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_naturalist1_1
Reply.text: Greetings, mercenary! I'm done with business, which means we can start taking orders. I just got one for you, with an interesting Ural assembly.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_naturalist1_3
Reply.text: So, we need to assemble Ural, with Morion cabin and Cold body, weapon Rainmetal and KPVT. Here, as always, is the instruction, you can read it.|@FF0000AA|Cabin: @FF1D1D1DMorion (Level IV)|Body: @FF1D1D1DCold (Level I)|Weapon: @FF1D1D1DRainmetal - x1, KPVT - x1|@FF0000AA|@FF1D1D1DReward:|- Body: @FF1D1D1DTiger (Ural, Level V) on sale|- Cabin: @FF1D1D1DBolivar (Belaz, Level II) on sale|- Body: @FF1D1D1DConstructor (Belaz, Level II) on sale|- Unknown reward|- Money: @FF1D1D1D65.000 coins

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_naturalist1_7
Reply.text: Glad to hear it, as always, everything is on track. Based on the tests, it would be better to replace the KPVT with another Rainmetal. I will let the customer know, you have done your job, the reward will be waiting for you in the body.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_naturalist2_1
Reply.text: Oh, it's you! Hi. I just got a new assignment for you. Listen, I need a Ural assembly with the ability to install two Vector machine guns, a cabin and a body of your choice, the main thing is that there are two machine guns. I know that Vectors are pretty mediocre in terms of killing power, but this is the requirement for the order. Can you handle it?|@FF0000AA|@FF1D1D1DReward:|- Cabin: @FF1D1D1DLord (Ural, Level III) on sale|- Body: @FF1D1D1DCylinder (Belaz, Level V) on sale|- Cannon: @FF1D1D1DCyclops on sale - x1|- Machine gun: @FF1D1D1DOctopus - x1|- Item: @FF1D1D1DAmmo box for Machine gun - x1|- Item: @FF1D1D1DAmmo box for Cannon - x1|- Money: @FF1D1D1D60.000 coins

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_naturalist2_2
Reply.text: Looks like I'll have to tinker around a bit.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_naturalist2_5
Reply.text: Great, you did well. However, based on the tests, we can say the following: Ural is a good machine, considering that it has good weapons. He-he. In general, if possible, it is better to replace Vectors with something better, for example, Rainmetal, an excellent gun.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_naturalist2_6
Reply.text: I completely agree with this statement.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_naturalist3_1
Reply.text: Hello mercenary! I guess you're already missing cool and killer builds, right?

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_naturalist3_2
Reply.text: I think you're right. It would be nice to ride something really good.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_naturalist3_3
Reply.text: I agree, I haven't had a chance to receive orders for interesting builds lately, but I do have one.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_naturalist3_5
Reply.text: Anyway, listen, we have to test the Ural build with Rainmetal and two Rapiers installed. Here, as always, is the full technical task, read it and get to work.|@FF0000AA|Cabin: @FF1D1D1DLord (Level III)|Body: @FF1D1D1DShell (Level IV)|Weapon: @FF1D1D1DRainmetal - x1, Rapier - x2|@FF0000AA|@FF1D1D1DReward:|- Body: @FF1D1D1DCruiser (Ural, Level III) on sale|- Cabin: @FF1D1D1DTerminator (Belaz, Level IV) on sale|- Gadget: @FF1D1D1DOptical sight with anti-reflective coating on sale - x1|- Machine gun: @FF1D1D1DOctopus - x1|- Item: @FF1D1D1DAmmo box for Machine gun - x1|- Money: @FF1D1D1D70.000 coins

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_naturalist3_6
Reply.text: Now let's see what kind of assembly this is.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_naturalist3_9
Reply.text: Wow! Real cannon combos, but for better balance it's better to install only one type of weapon. In this case, either Rainmetals or Rapiers, so the build will look much better. The task is completed, you can collect the reward.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_naturalist3_10
Reply.text: Okay, I'll take that into account when I build my own machine configurations.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_naturalist4_1
Reply.text: Hi, I have a job for you. Help me test the Ural build, with Cyclops and one Rainmetal installed, the rest of the weapons are your choice, the cabin too. Apparently the customer was interested in how the duet of these two guns would look. I think you can handle it.|@FF0000AA|Cabin: @FF1D1D1DAny|Body: @FF1D1D1DCruiser (Level III)|Weapon: @FF1D1D1DCyclops - x1, Rainmetal - x1|@FF0000AA|@FF1D1D1DReward:|- Cabin: @FF1D1D1DKnight (Ural, Level V) on sale|- Cabin: @FF1D1D1DRock (Belaz, Level III) on sale|- Gadget: @FF1D1D1DTurbocharger on sale - x1|- Machine gun: @FF1D1D1DOctopus on sale - x1|- Rocket launcher: @FF1D1D1DHunter on sale - x1|- Item: @FF1D1D1DAmmo box for Machine gun on sale - x1|- Item: @FF1D1D1DAmmunition box for Rocket launcher on sale - x1|- Money: @FF1D1D1D70.000 coins

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_naturalist4_5
Reply.text: Great, I knew you could handle it. I don't know what the customer came up with to equip the Ural with just one Rainmetal, but I'll just assume that he has nothing else. However, this didn't stop you from completing the order, and that's good, here's your reward.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_naturalist5_1
Reply.text: Hello mercenary. I have one last order for you to assemble a Ural, but it's very interesting, I think you'll like it.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_naturalist5_2
Reply.text: So, what kind of assembly is this?

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_naturalist5_3
Reply.text: So, the assembly should be as follows. We need to assemble a Ural truck with the ability to install an Octopus machine gun and three Rainmetal guns on it. Look at the instructions, everything is described here.|@FF0000AA|Cabin: @FF1D1D1DKnight (Level V)|Body: @FF1D1D1DCruiser (Level III)|Weapon: @FF1D1D1DRainmetal - x3, Octopus - x1|@FF0000AA|@FF1D1D1DReward:|- Transport: @FF1D1D1DPeacekeeper on sale|- Cabin: @FF1D1D1DScull (Peacekeeper, Level II) on sale|- Body: @FF1D1D1DCenturion (Peacekeeper, Level II) on sale|- Cabin: @FF1D1D1DShield (Belaz, Level V) on sale|- Body: @FF1D1D1DColossus (Belaz, Level III) on sale|- Body: @FF1D1D1DThunder (Belaz, Level IV) on sale|- Gadget: @FF1D1D1DBig fuel canister on sale - x1|- Cannon: @FF1D1D1DRainmetal on sale - x1|- Shotgun: @FF1D1D1DFlag - x1|- Item: @FF1D1D1DAmmo box for Cannon on sale - x1|- Item: @FF1D1D1DAmmo box for Shotgun - x1|- Money: @FF1D1D1D70.000 coins

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_naturalist5_7
Reply.text: Well done. Now we can say with confidence that this is the top-notch Ural build. The one who ordered it clearly knows his business. Your work on Ural builds is done, you can collect your reward. And come see me later, we will continue working with orders.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_belazist1_1
Reply.text: Hello, mercenary! The first batch of Belazs just arrived, so we can start working right now. Are you ready?

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_belazist1_2
Reply.text: Of course, difficulties don’t scare me.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_belazist1_3
Reply.text: Great, glad to hear it. With such an attitude, the work will go well. So, let's get down to business. The first order will be as follows: First, we just need to check the functionality of this machine, since we haven't received any upgrades yet, and since that's the case, your task is simply to test the Belaz in full stock, you can install the weapons to your taste.|@FF0000AA|@FF1D1D1DReward:|- Body: @FF1D1D1DTiger (Ural, Level V) on sale|- Cabin: @FF1D1D1DBolivar (Belaz, Level II) on sale|- Body: @FF1D1D1DConstructor (Belaz, Level II) on sale|- Unknown reward|- Money: @FF1D1D1D65.000 coins

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_belazist1_4
Reply.text: And again a stock car, but apparently I have no other choice.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_belazist1_7
Reply.text: Well... But this was to be expected, Belaz with such a configuration was never intended for battles, first of all it is construction equipment, but oh well, in the near future we should receive the first improvements, so we'll see what this miracle equipment is capable of.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_belazist1_8
Reply.text: Well, I hope the Belazs can live up to expectations.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_belazist2_1
Reply.text: Hello! It's good to see you again. We've received the first improvements, so I'm giving you the next order right away. Here's the instruction, make such an assembly so that you can install two Kord machine guns on the cabin and one KPVT machine gun on the body, and then test it in battle. You haven't let me down yet, so I think you can handle it.|@FF0000AA|Cabin: @FF1D1D1DBolivar (Level II)|Body: @FF1D1D1DConstructor (Level II)|Weapon: @FF1D1D1DKord - x2, KPVT - x1|@FF0000AA|@FF1D1D1DReward:|- Cabin: @FF1D1D1DLord (Ural, Level III) on sale|- Cabin: @FF1D1D1DTerminator (Belaz, Level IV) on sale|- Body: @FF1D1D1DCylinder (Belaz, Level V) on sale|- Cannon: @FF1D1D1DCyclops on sale - x1|- Gadget: @FF1D1D1DTurbocharger - x1|- Machine gun: @FF1D1D1DOctopus - x1|- Item: @FF1D1D1DAmmo box for Machine gun - x1|- Item: @FF1D1D1DAmmo box for Cannon - x1|- Money: @FF1D1D1D60.000 coins

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_belazist2_5
Reply.text: This assembly is clearly better than the previous one. About 5%. But it's not your fault, the work is done as always perfectly. You can take the reward, and in the meantime I'll go get new parts and think about how to improve the assembly.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_belazist3_1
Reply.text: Oh, hi, yes, there is one order. This assembly already looks much better, here you can see for yourself. We need to assemble a Belaz and install two Rainmetal cannons on it, we have the necessary spare parts for this in stock, so there will be no problems with the assembly.|@FF0000AA|Cabin: @FF1D1D1DTerminator (Level IV)|Body: @FF1D1D1DCylinder (Level V)|Weapon: @FF1D1D1DRainmetal - x2|@FF0000AA|@FF1D1D1DReward:|- Body: @FF1D1D1DCruiser (Ural, Level III) on sale|- Cabin: @FF1D1D1DRock (Belaz, Level III) on sale|- Gadget: @FF1D1D1DOptical sight with anti-reflective coating on sale - x1|- Gadget: @FF1D1D1DTurbocharger - x1|- Machine gun: @FF1D1D1DOctopus - x1|- Machine gun: @FF1D1D1DRainmetal - x1|- Item: @FF1D1D1DAmmo box for Machine gun - x1|- Item: @FF1D1D1DAmmo box for Cannon - x1|- Money: @FF1D1D1D70.000 coins

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_belazist3_2
Reply.text: Great, wait for me with the finished tests.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_belazist3_5
Reply.text: Yeah, judging by the tests, the result suits me. Rainmetals fit well into this build, and since that's the case, we'll move in that direction. So... Let's see what we can do with this. Your work is done, you can go, and don't forget about the reward.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_belazist4_1
Reply.text: Hello mercenary. I have one order for you, it would be nice to make this build and test it in battle. Are you ready?

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_belazist4_3
Reply.text: Here. Look at the instructions. Assemble this Belaz, install an Octopus machine gun on the cabin, and Rainmetal on the body. By the way, you can choose any body, the main thing is to install Rainmetal on it. Is everything clear? Then good luck with the assembly.|@FF0000AA|Cabin: @FF1D1D1DRock (Level III)|Body: @FF1D1D1DAny|Weapon: @FF1D1D1DOctopus - x1, Rainmetal - x1|@FF0000AA|@FF1D1D1DReward:|- Cabin: @FF1D1D1DKnight (Ural, Level V) on sale|- Body: @FF1D1D1DThunder (Belaz, Level IV) on sale|- Gadget: @FF1D1D1DTurbocharger on sale - x1|- Machine gun: @FF1D1D1DOctopus on sale - x1|- Rocket launcher: @FF1D1D1DHunter on sale - x1|- Item: @FF1D1D1DAmmo box for Machine gun on sale - x1|- Item: @FF1D1D1DAmmunition box for Rocket launcher on sale - x1|- Money: @FF1D1D1D70.000 coins

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_belazist4_7
Reply.text: Great. The only downside to this build is that it doesn't have enough weapons. If only we could add another cannon here... Ah. Okay. I think we'll solve this issue somehow. The job is done, you can go.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_belazist4_8
Reply.text: Excellent, I will wait for new orders.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_belazist5_1
Reply.text: Greetings, mercenary! It's good that you came by, I have one order for you with a rather unusual assembly, it would be nice to test it.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_belazist5_3
Reply.text: Look, Belaz needs to be fitted with giant guns, you've encountered them before, only here we need as many as 3 of them. Unusual build, it will be interesting to see its firepower in battle. I think you can help me with this.|@FF0000AA|Cabin: @FF1D1D1DRock (Level III)|Body: @FF1D1D1DThunder (Level IV)|Weapon: @FF1D1D1DAny|@FF0000AA|@FF1D1D1DReward:|- Body: @FF1D1D1DColossus (Belaz, Level III) on sale|- Gadget: @FF1D1D1DBig fuel canister on sale - x1|- Gadget: @FF1D1D1DTurbocharger - x1|- Cannon: @FF1D1D1DRainmetal on sale - x1|- Shotgun: @FF1D1D1DFlag - x1|- Item: @FF1D1D1DAmmo box for Cannon on sale - x1|- Item: @FF1D1D1DAmmo box for Shotgun - x1|- Money: @FF1D1D1D70.000 coins

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_belazist5_4
Reply.text: Deal! This is not the first time I have fought.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_belazist5_7
Reply.text: My instincts didn't let me down. The build really turned out interesting. Of all the giant guns, the best one in my opinion is the Octopus machine gun. If you have a choice of what to put from such weapons, don't hesitate to put the Octopus, you won't regret it. Here's a reward for good work.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_belazist5_8
Reply.text: Thanks for the advice, I'll take it into account.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_belazist6_1
Reply.text: Hello, mercenary. I keep thinking, it's good that we finally got to work together. You help me a lot with the assemblies and you yourself are becoming more experienced.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_belazist6_2
Reply.text: Let me guess. Are you trying to give me an inconvenient order again?

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_belazist6_3
Reply.text: Right. I have something for you. But this order is normal. I try to filter orders and take mainly those with good assemblies. Besides, we have enough spare parts for this.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_belazist6_4
Reply.text: What kind of order is this?

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_belazist6_5
Reply.text: I see you're interested, here, look. Assemble the Belaz so that three Rainmetal cannons can be mounted on it. As for me, the assembly is excellent, so you can handle it. I'll wait for you with the results.|@FF0000AA|@FF1D1D1DReward:|- Cabin: @FF1D1D1DShield (Belaz, Level V) on sale|- Gadget: @FF1D1D1DBlowback system with floating coupling on sale - x1|- Gadget: @FF1D1D1D''Sagitta'' system - x1|- Cannon: @FF1D1D1DRainmetal - x1|- Item: @FF1D1D1DAmmo box for Cannon - x1|- Money: @FF1D1D1D75.000 coins

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_belazist6_9
Reply.text: Very good, as expected from three Rainmetals, the results are excellent. Only the slot for the small gun in this build is completely out of place, compared to Rainmetals or other similar class guns, the small slot looks superfluous. But... okay. You did your job, here's the reward.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_belazist6_10
Reply.text: It's still nice to work with such orders.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_belazist7_1
Reply.text: Hi. You are just in time, I have just one order left for you, this will be the last one for the Belaz assembly.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_belazist7_3
Reply.text: I think you'll like this build. The order calls for a Belaz to be assembled and equipped with one Cyclops, one Flag shotgun, and two Rainmetal cannons. As far as I understand, the whole point of this build is to deal massive damage in one hit. It'll be interesting to see if that's true. I'm waiting for your results.|@FF0000AA|Cabin: @FF1D1D1DShield (Level V)|Body: @FF1D1D1DColossus (Level III)|Weapon: @FF1D1D1DCyclops - x1, Flag - x1, Rainmetal - x2|@FF0000AA|@FF1D1D1DReward:|- Transport: @FF1D1D1DPeacekeeper on sale|- Gadget: @FF1D1D1DRolled armour plates with additional cementing on sale - x1|- Gadget: @FF1D1D1D''Sagitta'' system - x1|- Shotgun: @FF1D1D1DFlag on sale - x1|- Item: @FF1D1D1DAmmo box for Shotgun on sale - x1|- Money: @FF1D1D1D90.000 coins

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_belazist7_4
Reply.text: The task is clear, expect the test drive results from me.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_belazist7_7
Reply.text: Excellent. The customer really wanted the build to do devastating damage in one shot, but he miscalculated with the Rainmetal. Although they are considered guns, in fact they are automatic, which is not part of the concept of this build. To achieve the desired result, the Rainmetals need to be replaced with something single-shot, Rapiers or Flags will do just fine. It seems I've talked too much, although maybe you'll notice something important for yourself. Your last order for the Belazs is complete. We still have work to do on other vehicles, but for now you can go, Thank you for your help.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_belazist8_1
Reply.text: Hello mercenary, I have a little business. As I said, the last order for Belaz was supposed to be the last, but it was not to be. An order for another assembly came in and it is quite unusual, I have not seen anything like this for a long time.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_belazist8_2
Reply.text: So, what kind of assembly is this?

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_belazist8_3
Reply.text: The customer has a rather unusual taste in technology, he asks to assemble a Belaz and install three Bumblebee on it. These are mortars that shoot a flat trajectory, it will not be easy to hit the enemy with such weapons. I will be grateful if you help me, here, take a look at the instructions.|@FF0000AA|Cabin: @FF1D1D1DShield (Level V)|Body: @FF1D1D1DColossus (Level III)|Weapon: @FF1D1D1DBumblebee - x3|@FF0000AA|@FF1D1D1DReward:|- Cabin: @FF1D1D1DMeteor (Peacekeeper, Level III) on sale @FF780a0a[If not received earlier]|- Body: @FF1D1D1DMaya (Peacekeeper, Level III) on sale @FF780a0a[If not received earlier]|- Gadget: @FF1D1D1D''Sagitta'' system - x1|- Gadget: @FF1D1D1D''Albatross'' system - x1|- Item: @FF1D1D1DAmmo box for Cannon - x1|- Item: @FF1D1D1DAmmo box for Shotgun - x1|- Item: @FF1D1D1DAmmunition box for Artillery on sale - x1|- Unknown reward - @FF1D1D1Dx3|- Money: @FF1D1D1D200.000 coins

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_belazist8_4
Reply.text: Well, let's see what comes of this.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_belazist8_7
Reply.text: Well... A disappointing result. I think you understand everything about the assembly. We probably won't judge the one who ordered this assembly. Everyone has their own tastes, and we are decent people, so we won't interfere with this. Of course, you surprised me, you completed such an order, i'm didn't expect it. I think you deserve a valuable reward, something like this should be well paid.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_belazist8_8
Reply.text: Well said. I completely agree with everything.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_test_drive9_1
Reply.text: Oh, it's you, hello! I finished some things so I have some work for you.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_test_drive9_2
Reply.text: I am listening carefully. What should I do?

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_test_drive9_3
Reply.text: There is one order, the customer asks to assemble a Peacekeeper and install one Flag shotgun and one Cyclops cannon on it. There is nothing complicated, so there will be no difficulties.|@FF0000AA|Cabin: @FF1D1D1DScull (Level II)|Body: @FF1D1D1DCenturion (Level II)|Weapon: @FF1D1D1DFlag - x1, Cyclops - x1|@FF0000AA|@FF1D1D1DReward:|- Cabin: @FF1D1D1DBulat (Peacekeeper, Level IV) on sale|- Body: @FF1D1D1DMasamune (Peacekeeper, Level IV) on sale|- Gadget: @FF1D1D1DRolled armour plates with additional cementing on sale - x1|- Rocket launcher: @FF1D1D1DHail - x1|- Laser launcher: @FF1D1D1DOdin - x1|- Item: @FF1D1D1DAmmunition box for Rocket launcher - x1|- Item: @FF1D1D1DLiquid cylinder for Laser launcher - x1|- Money: @FF1D1D1D100.000 coins

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_test_drive9_7
Reply.text: Even though the Peacekeeper is the most technologically advanced truck, it lacks in the amount of weapons in this build. However, thanks to a good selection of guns, it has lethal power. But there is no right to make a mistake, if you miss, you are dead! So... then. You have completed the task, so, as always, you are entitled to a reward.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_test_drive9_8
Reply.text: Thank you for the award and the advice you received.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_test_drive10_1
Reply.text: Hi, I have a job for you. I need a Peacekeeper that can mount 3 big guns, meaning with 3 big slots. Everything else is up to you.|@FF0000AA|@FF1D1D1DReward:|- Cabin: @FF1D1D1DMeteor (Peacekeeper, Level III) on sale @FF780a0a[If not received earlier]|- Body: @FF1D1D1DMaya (Peacekeeper, Level III) on sale @FF780a0a[If not received earlier]|- Gadget: @FF1D1D1DBlowback system with floating coupling on sale - x1|- Machine gun: @FF1D1D1DOctopus on sale - x1|- Cannon: @FF1D1D1DRainmetal on sale - x1|- Shotgun: @FF1D1D1DFlag on sale - x1|- Item: @FF1D1D1DAmmo box for Machine gun - x1|- Item: @FF1D1D1DAmmo box for Cannon - x1|- Item: @FF1D1D1DAmmo box for Shotgun - x1|- Money: @FF1D1D1D100.000 coins

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_test_drive10_2
Reply.text: The task is clear, I get to work.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_test_drive10_5
Reply.text: With this amount of armament, the Peacekeeper is already becoming quite a workhorse. The job is done, the customer will be happy.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_test_drive11_1
Reply.text: Hello mercenary. I have a cool order for you to build a Peacekeeper. Interested?

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_test_drive11_3
Reply.text: You need to assemble a Peacekeeper and install three Rainmetals and one Octopus on it. You know, the guns are pretty powerful, the assembly will be good. Here are the instructions, read them.|@FF0000AA|Cabin: @FF1D1D1DMeteor (Level III)|Body: @FF1D1D1DMaya (Level III)|Weapon: @FF1D1D1DRainmetal - x3, Octopus - x1|@FF0000AA|@FF1D1D1DReward:|- Transport: @FF1D1D1DCruiser on sale|- Body: @FF1D1D1DExcalibur (Peacekeeper, Level V) on sale|- Gadget: @FF1D1D1DElectromechanical complex ''Spheno'' - x1|- Laser launcher: @FF1D1D1DOdin - x1|- Item: @FF1D1D1DLiquid cylinder for Laser launcher - x1|- Item: @FF1D1D1DHigh-tech electronics - x4|- Money: @FF1D1D1D110.000 coins

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_test_drive11_7
Reply.text: Okay, your job is done. There's nothing to say, the build turned out great. So, here's your reward for the work you've done.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_test_drive12_1
Reply.text: Hi, I have a job. The build is a bit similar to the previous one, but with different weapons. You need to install three Flag shotguns and one Cyclops cannon on the Peacekeeper. The entire power of the weapon is contained in one shot, so misses are not allowed. But you, a mercenary, are already an experienced fighter, so I have no doubt in you. Let's get to work!|@FF0000AA|Cabin: @FF1D1D1DBulat (Level IV)|Body: @FF1D1D1DExcalibur (Level V)|Weapon: @FF1D1D1DFlag - x3, Cyclops - x1|@FF0000AA|@FF1D1D1DReward:|- Cabin: @FF1D1D1DPhantom (Peacekeeper, Level V) on sale|- Gadget: @FF1D1D1D''FireEye'' complex - x1|- Plasma gun: @FF1D1D1DElephant - x1|- Shotgun: @FF1D1D1DFlag on sale - x1|- Item: @FF1D1D1DLiquid cylinder for Plasma gun - x1|- Item: @FF1D1D1DAmmo box for Shotgun - x1|- Money: @FF1D1D1D120.000 coins

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_test_drive12_5
Reply.text: I knew you could handle it. Otherwise, I wouldn't have offered such an order. The assembly is excellent, but complicated, and doesn't forgive mistakes. Here's your reward, you can go.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_test_drive12_6
Reply.text: Thanks. The build is a bit complicated, but I enjoyed dealing a ton of damage in one shot.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_test_drive12_7
Reply.text: Thank you. I didn't like the weapons in this build, I'd still prefer something automatic.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_test_drive13_1
Reply.text: Oh, good to see you. I have a reference build for Peacekeeper for you. I think you might be interested in it.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_test_drive13_2
Reply.text: Continue. What kind of assembly is this?

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_test_drive13_3
Reply.text: Anyway, listen. Assemble the Peacekeeper in its top configuration, and install two Octopus machine guns and two Rainmetal cannons as weapons. There is nothing complicated, so you can handle it. I will wait for your results.|@FF0000AA|@FF1D1D1DReward:|- Gadget: @FF1D1D1DElectromechanical complex ''Spheno'' on sale - x1|- Gadget: @FF1D1D1D''FireEye'' complex on sale - x1|- Gadget: @FF1D1D1D''Sagitta'' system on sale - x1|- Item: @FF1D1D1DHigh-tech electronics - x5|- Money: @FF1D1D1D100.000 coins

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_test_drive13_4
Reply.text: This will be an interesting assembly, I'll get to work.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_test_drive13_7
Reply.text: This is the top-end truck assembly to date. The best choice of cabin with a body, perfectly matches the installed weapons. Considering all this, I think you were quite comfortable fighting, driving this machine. The results are excellent, the order is completed, here is your reward.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_test_drive13_8
Reply.text: Thank you. This is the best thing I've ridden in a long time.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_test_drive13_9
Reply.text: Thanks for the award. But to tell you the truth, Belaz seemed to me a more advanced truck, but oh well. Maybe I didn't understand something.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_test_drive14_1
Reply.text: Hello mercenary, I have a new order for you.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_test_drive14_3
Reply.text: The order requires assembling a Cruiser truck in the basic configuration, and installing Octopus and KPVT machine guns as weapons. The assembly is not the ultimate, but you will have no trouble testing it.|@FF0000AA|@FF1D1D1DReward:|- Cabin: @FF1D1D1DCruiser's cabin (Level II) on sale|- Body: @FF1D1D1DCruiser's cargo 8x12 (Level II) on sale|- Gadget: @FF1D1D1DElectronic injector system - x1|- Gadget: @FF1D1D1D''Doom-4'' system - x1|- Laser launcher: @FF1D1D1DOdin - x1|- Item: @FF1D1D1DLiquid cylinder for Laser launcher - x1|- Money: @FF1D1D1D130.000 coins

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_test_drive14_7
Reply.text: Accepted. The build is not very good, I agree. Too few slots for good weapons. But I think we'll figure something out. The job is done, you can collect your reward.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_test_drive14_8
Reply.text: After the Peacekeeper, the Cruiser looks hopeless. I still don't understand why people order it.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_test_drive15_1
Reply.text: Hello mercenary. I have an order for a new build for the Cruiser. I will need your help.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_test_drive15_2
Reply.text: Okay. Tell me what needs to be done.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_test_drive15_3
Reply.text: Assemble a Cruiser in the top configuration, we have all the necessary spare parts for this. And also install two Odin laser launchers and any side gun, you have probably already met them, such weapons are installed in a special slot on the car body. And their trick is that they are located on both sides of the body, that's why they are called «side gun». And so, we are done with the lecture, we can get down to business.|@FF0000AA|@FF1D1D1DReward:|- Gadget: @FF1D1D1DRolled armour plates with additional cementing on sale - x1|- Gadget: @FF1D1D1DMagnetic-optical system ''Quasar'' - x1|- Gadget: @FF1D1D1D''Doom-4'' system - x1|- Gadget: @FF1D1D1D''Albatross'' system - x1|- Item: @FF1D1D1DLiquid cylinder for Laser launcher - x1|- Item: @FF1D1D1DLiquid cylinder for Plasma gun - x1|- Item: @FF1D1D1DAmmunition box for Rocket launcher - x1|- Item: @FF1D1D1DAmmunition box for Artillery - x1|- Money: @FF1D1D1D130.000 coins

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_test_drive15_4
Reply.text: The task is clear, wait for the report.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_test_drive15_7
Reply.text: Very good. Laser guns showed themselves quite well in this build. Quite a deadly device, capable of literally burning away enemy armor. And as for the side guns, the situation is not clear-cut. They are all similar and have the same problems, long reload and small ammunition. But as always, the work is done flawlessly, so you can take the reward.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_bitok1_1
Reply.text: Hello! Look, do you know what this is?

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_bitok1_4
Reply.text: That's right! You know, the more time I spend doing this, the more I realize that this is the future. A new digital age, where all the computing processes are done by machines.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_bitok1_5
Reply.text: This is a Bitcoin farm. You know, the more time I spend doing this, the more I realize that this is the future. A new digital age, where all the computing processes are done by machines.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_bitok1_6
Reply.text: And you need my help with this.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_bitok1_7
Reply.text: Yes. I need some parts, bring me some cables, T-Shaped plug and power supplies. Don't worry about the reward, everything will be in full.|@FF0000AA|@FF1D1D1DReward:|- Machine gun: @FF1D1D1DKPVT - x1|- Item: @FF1D1D1DHigh-tech electronics - x2|- Money: @FF1D1D1D35.000 coins
