Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_bitok1_12
Reply.scriptCondition: HasPlayerAmountOfItems('item_bp', 1) and GetVar('q_bitok1_item_bp').AsInt>=1 and IsQuestTaken('q_bitok1_3') and not(IsQuestComplete('q_bitok1_3'))

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_bitok1_15
Reply.text: Thank you, I think that will be enough for now. I have already put your reward in the back of the truck. Come see me later, I have to work now.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_bitok2_1
Reply.text: Hello again! I just finished the work. Now I need computer components: CPUs, coolers and boards. Bring them to me, and then almost everything will be ready.|@FF0000AA|@FF1D1D1DReward:|- Gadget: @FF1D1D1DAir cooling system for bullet weapons on sale - x1|- Money: @FF1D1D1D40.000 coins
Reply.nextReplies: Dlg_npc_q_bitok2_2 Dlg_npc_q_bitok2_3 Dlg_npc_q_bitok2_4 Dlg_npc_q_bitok2_5 Dlg_npc_q_bitok2_6 Dlg_npc_q_bitok2_7 Dlg_npc_q_bitok2_8 Dlg_npc_q_bitok2_9 Dlg_npc_q_bitok2_10

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_bitok2_2
Reply.text: I hope it's really worth it.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_bitok2_3
Reply.scriptCondition: HasPlayerAmountOfItems('item_cpu', 1) and not(GetVar('q_bitok2_item_cpu').AsInt>=2) and IsQuestTaken('q_bitok2_1') and not(IsQuestComplete('q_bitok2_1'))

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_bitok2_4
Reply.scriptCondition: HasPlayerAmountOfItems('item_cpu', 1) and GetVar('q_bitok2_item_cpu').AsInt>=2 and IsQuestTaken('q_bitok2_1') and not(IsQuestComplete('q_bitok2_1'))

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_bitok2_5
Reply.scriptCondition: HasPlayerAmountOfItems('item_cooler', 1) and not(GetVar('q_bitok2_item_cooler').AsInt>=2) and IsQuestTaken('q_bitok2_2') and not(IsQuestComplete('q_bitok2_2'))

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_bitok2_6
Reply.scriptCondition: HasPlayerAmountOfItems('item_cooler', 1) and GetVar('q_bitok2_item_cooler').AsInt>=2 and IsQuestTaken('q_bitok2_2') and not(IsQuestComplete('q_bitok2_2'))

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_bitok2_7
Reply.scriptCondition: HasPlayerAmountOfItems('item_plate', 1) and not(GetVar('q_bitok2_item_plate').AsInt>=2) and IsQuestTaken('q_bitok2_3') and not(IsQuestComplete('q_bitok2_3'))

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_bitok2_8
Reply.scriptCondition: HasPlayerAmountOfItems('item_plate', 1) and GetVar('q_bitok2_item_plate').AsInt>=2 and IsQuestTaken('q_bitok2_3') and not(IsQuestComplete('q_bitok2_3'))

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_bitok2_11
Reply.text: Great. Now all that's left is to assemble everything. Come see me when I'm done. Oh, and don't forget the reward.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_bitok2_12
Reply.text: Well, okay. It will be interesting to see what comes of this.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_bitok3_1
Reply.text: Hi. You see, before all this apocalypse, I often ordered various components and parts from cars via the Internet. It is very convenient and sometimes cheaper.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_bitok3_3
Reply.text: Since I was already starting to work on the Bitcoin farm, I ordered four batches of video cards in advance, but unfortunately only two arrived. As you can see, I still need the missing video cards. Tracking of the goods was interrupted in the city of South, I think it is still there. If you manage to find it, you will help me a lot.|@FF0000AA|@FF1D1D1DReward:|- Unknown reward

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_bitok3_4
Reply.text: Okay, I'll try to look for your video cards.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_bitok3_5
Reply.scriptCondition: HasPlayerAmountOfItems('item_quest_box_videocard', 1) and IsQuestTaken('q_bitok3') and not(IsQuestComplete('q_bitok3_2')) and IsQuestComplete('q_bitok3_1') and IsQuestComplete('q_bitok3_22')

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_bitok3_7
Reply.text: You really found them! Thank you. The most important thing is that they are unharmed. What good will they be if they are damaged?

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_bitok3_8
Reply.text: Finally, now you can finish your Bitcoin farm. I hope it will pay off its costs.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_turbo_1
Reply.text: Hi. It's so good that you stopped by, I need your help. Look. See what I have. This is Turbo, in my own version. A device that allows you to speed up your car by one and a half times in 5 seconds. A useful thing, with which you can get to the desired point faster, or vice versa, quickly get away from pursuers. In general, I need you to help test this device for possible malfunctions in the equipment.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_turbo_2
Reply.text: Sounds interesting, tell me what needs to be done.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_turbo_3
Reply.text: Install the Turbo accelerator in a special slot under the car body, the system should immediately detect it. Then nothing complicated, press the button and the car accelerates. Just keep an eye on the amount of nitro, here is a can in case the supply runs out. Well, I think I explained everything, there should be no problems, I know my business. I will wait for results from you.|@FF0000AA|@FF1D1D1DReward:|- Item: @FF1D1D1DTurbo on sale - x1|- Item: @FF1D1D1DAir cylinder for Turbo on sale - x1|- Money: @FF1D1D1D30.000 coins

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_turbo_4
Reply.text: It doesn't look difficult, I can handle it.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_turbo_7
Reply.text: Great, glad everything went well. You helped me a lot, now I can confidently launch mass production, and then send it for sale.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_turbo_8
Reply.text: Cool device, I will continue to use it.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_daily_kill_pmc_mechanik_1
Reply.text: Hello, mercenary. I need your help. I need to eliminate a certain number of targets. The job is just right for you. Will you help?|@FF0000AA|@FF1D1D1DObjectives:|- Kill a certain number of PMC fighters||@FF0000AA|@FF1D1D1DReward:|- Unknown reward

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_daily_kill_pmc_mechanik_5
Reply.text: Did you manage? Thanks, you helped me out. Here's your reward.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_daily_kill_scav_mechanik_1
Reply.text: Greetings, mercenary! Will you help me with one thing? I ordered the necessary spare parts, but there is a risk that the transport may run into an ambush along the way. The area there is far from safe, there are plenty of bandits there. Will you help me deal with them? I'll give you a tip.|@FF0000AA|@FF1D1D1DObjectives:|- Kill a certain number of scavs||@FF0000AA|@FF1D1D1DReward:|- Unknown reward

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_daily_kill_scav_mechanik_5
Reply.text: Excellent. Thanks to you, I got the desired product. And in return, you get a reward.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_daily_extract_r1m1_mechanik_1
Reply.text: Mercenary, give me a few minutes. I have prepared an order for the clients, but they require a guarantee that the route to the meeting place is safe. If you are not busy, can you look for a route for them? What and how according to the situation in the area and how to retreat if necessary, well, you get the idea. I will not remain in debt.|@FF0000AA|@FF1D1D1DObjectives:|- Survive and exit the Krai location a certain number of times||@FF0000AA|@FF1D1D1DReward:|- Unknown reward

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_q_daily_extract_mechanik_5
Reply.text: You back? Great. I'll mark a safe route on the map, thanks. Take your reward.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_mechanic_master
Reply.text: With me you can improve your weapons and spare parts for your car. I am the only experienced specialist in this field, I understand both technology and guns. If you are interested, then show me what needs to be modified.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_mechanic_master_1
Reply.text: I want to modify part of the car.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_mechanic_mod_part_0

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_buyer_1
Reply.text: So, let's be brief and to the point. What have you come for?

Reply.name: Dlg_pl_buyer_exit
Reply.text: Sorry, I think I've come to the wrong place.

Reply.name: Dlg_pl_buyer_2
Reply.text: I want to ask the Scavs for help.
Reply.scriptCondition: 15000 >= GetPlayerMoney() and GetPlayerMaxFuel() == 0 and GetPlayerMaxHealth() == 100 and getObj('ChestFromScavCar') == nil

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_buyer_3
Reply.text: Unfortunately, the Scavs won't be able to help you in the near future, they have their own business. If your request is relevant, try to contact me later.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_buyer_4
Reply.text: Looks like we'll have to wait.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_buyer_5
Reply.text: Okay. The Scavs will arrive shortly. Wait.

Reply.name: Dlg_pl_Scav_give_money
Reply.text: Bro, help me out. Can you spare a few coins?

Reply.name: Dlg_pl_Scav_give_use_items
Reply.text: Do you have any extra spare parts or cans of fuel for car?

Reply.name: Dlg_pl_Scav_give_ammo
Reply.text: Bro, I need ammo! It's a matter of life and death.

Reply.name: Dlg_pl_Scav_follow
Reply.text: The gang and I are going to cause some trouble in the area. Are you with us?

Reply.name: Dlg_pl_Scav_del_follow
Reply.text: The job is done. Thanks for your help.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_Scav_give_money_1
Reply.text: If you have something in return, like something to drink, then fine, we can come to an agreement.

Reply.name: Dlg_pl_Scav_give_money_1_1
Reply.text: Are you interested in other subjects?

Reply.name: Dlg_pl_Scav_give_money_2
Reply.text: Listen, give me the money the good way, while I'm still kind!

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_Scav_give_money_3
Reply.text: This is where we should have started the conversation. I like this. Give it here!

Reply.name: Dlg_pl_Scav_give_money_4
Reply.scriptResult: TDeactivate('PressHornToSpeekScav'); AddScavCarma('+', '0.1'); SetVar('DlgMoney_'..GetVar('ScavCarNPC').AsString, 2); SetVar('ScavNPC', '0'); SetVar('ScavCarNPC', '0'); RemoveItemsFromPlayerRepository('item_vodka', 1); AddFadingMsgByStrIdFormatted('fm_item_to_npc', 'item_vodka'); AddPlayerMoney(random(5000, 12000)); EndConversation()

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_select_bear
Reply.text: Battle Encounter Assault Regiment (BEAR) is a private military company (PMC) used by government agencies to uncover any evidence of illegal activities by the Terra Group.

Reply.name: Dlg_npc_select_usec
Reply.text: United Security (USEC) is a private military company (PMC), works for the international corporation Terra Group, actively participates in armed clashes that hinder the investigation of Terra Group activities carried out by local authorities. Moreover, according to intelligence agencies, USEC provides armed cover for the illegal work and research of a foreign company.
